_doc: Firing smoke of tank guns, the PaK 40 and the Flak 18 (Fx::muzzle) and the launcher backblast (Fx::backblast). Read once at start-up by fx.cpp (docs/settings.md#firing-smoke). Sizes scale with the gun's muzzleScale (vehicle JSON gun.muzzleScale, station muzzleScale). Alpha fades as (life left)^fadePow after a quick fade-in. Before 2026-11 the discharge left 20 puffs at alpha 0.5-0.55 living 3-5 s.

smallArms._doc: WS1 / WS2 (the user: intensify muzzle smoke for WW2 guns; then: an oblong cone from the barrel, a flash on every shot): each shot of a WW2 small arm (weapon json smoke, default 1; modern, blaster, launcher and flame guns 0) leaves puffs x smoke AT the muzzle, each along the bore within spreadDeg, the later ones faster (speed) and larger, so the cloud strings out forward (about 0.4-1.4 m before drag stops it) and widens; sprites stretch along their drift; then rise (lift), grow and fade as (life left)^fadePow. Sized against the user's Garand reference (docs/garand_ads_fire_reference.md). Each gun has a budget of perGunBurst puffs topped up at perGunPuffsPerSecond, so automatic fire keeps a thin stream, not a wall. flashMinYref / flashMinLife: a period gun's flash core at least this x Yref (the disc half, the vortex a quarter) and this long, so it shows in daylight and at 60 fps for 3 frames; night flashes are above it. Perf switch ww2smoke (the smoke).
